name: Chattermill
oneLiner: Customer experience intelligence platform that unifies feedback from surveys, reviews, support conversations and social media and analyzes it with its own AI, Lyra.
bestFor: Large consumer brands, including multi-country restaurant and hospitality groups, with high feedback volume across many channels and an insights or CX team to act on it.

updates.text: Introduced Observations and Highlights (proactive surfacing of changes in feedback) and Ask Lyra, a natural-language interface for questioning customer feedback data.

features: Brings surveys, NPS, app and public reviews, support tickets and social comments into one dataset
Lyra AI tags themes and sentiment per topic, going beyond keyword matching
Ask Lyra: ask questions about feedback in plain language
Observations and Highlights that flag emerging issues and shifts automatically
Segmentation by market, location, customer type or time period
Role-based dashboards and reporting for different teams
APIs and MCP support so AI agents and other tools can work with the analyzed data
Lyra Agent (early preview): an AI agent that runs automated analysis across the platform

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Chattermill does not publish prices.

notes: No restaurant customer named publicly was found; closest hospitality customer is Limehome (serviced apartments), via a case study listed on G2. A chattermill.com testimonial mentions restaurant satisfaction by country and city but the company is not clear, so not used. Deliveroo appears only in older funding press as a client, not used. Uber and Wise case study titles come from casestudies.com; verify on chattermill.com/customers. Lyra Agent launch is undated (early-access page https://chattermill.com/lyra-agent-early-access and a LinkedIn post), so it is a feature, not a dated update. Original review had no stats to drop. Fit note: enterprise CX analytics rather than a restaurant-specific tool.
